recognize_zh: 中高倍下左半部是成片細胞質鮮紅、雙葉核的嗜酸性球，右半部則是小淋巴球、較大活化淋巴細胞與組織球混合的多形性背景；淋巴結內大量嗜酸性球浸潤可見於 IgG4 相關病變、寄生蟲或過敏反應，需排除何杰金氏淋巴瘤與朗格漢斯組織球增生症。
features: Sheets of eosinophils with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and bilobed nuclei
Adjacent polymorphous population of small lymphocytes and larger activated lymphoid cells
Scattered histiocytes and small vessels in the polymorphous area
No Reed-Sternberg-like cells or grooved Langerhans cells evident in this field
No eosinophilic abscess with central necrosis seen
describe_en: Sections show a lymph node with a dense infiltrate of eosinophils forming sheets in one area, merging with a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, larger activated lymphoid cells and histiocytes. Eosinophilic microabscesses with necrosis are not seen in this field. Reed-Sternberg-like cells and Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei are not identified. The findings represent a reactive lymphadenopathy with marked tissue eosinophilia, which can be seen in IgG4-related lymphadenopathy, parasitic or drug reactions, and Kimura disease; exclusion of classic Hodgkin lymphoma and Langerhans cell histiocytosis is recommended.

ddx.vs: CHL contains scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background.
LCH shows sinusoidal clusters of cells with grooved nuclei that are CD1a/langerin-positive, often with eosinophilic abscesses.
Kimura disease features florid follicular hyperplasia with eosinophilic microabscesses, polykaryocytes and markedly elevated serum IgE.
AITL shows expanded paracortex with clear-cell atypical T cells, arborizing HEVs and expanded CD21+ dendritic meshworks.
